faqs.q: Sec. 62-122. - Offer, sale or other transfer; to minors.
faqs.a:
It shall be unlawful for any person to sell, give, furnish, deliver or otherwise transfer,
               or offer to sell, give, furnish, deliver or otherwise transfer, any substance releasing
               toxic vapors to any person under the age of 18 years, without the oral or written
               consent of a parent or guardian of such person, except for the sale or offer of sale
               to such person of one ounce or less of any substance releasing toxic vapors.
(Code 1981, § 21-57; Ord. No. 738, § 3, 10-21-1968)
